//@version=5
indicator("uct-hma-macd-parity-v1", overlay=false)
hma20 = ta.hma(close, 20)
[macdLine, signalLine, histLine] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
plot(hma20, title="hma20")
plot(macdLine, title="macdLine")
plot(signalLine, title="signalLine")
plot(histLine, title="histLine")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.hma(close,20)/ta.macd(close,12,26,9) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04). The SIGNAL line is a member-composed formula per closedTable.json's own documented convention -- UCT has no native macdSignal builtin. This composition is TWICE-recursive: it is an EMA(9) (ast_interpret. _ema_col, its OWN SMA-of-window seed) applied to a macd LINE that already carries its own seed-convergence lag from two internal EMAs -- the signal's own seed error compounds on top of the line's, and it converges slower than the line alone as a result.

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 210 is NOT the semantic period-warmup (that is 33 bars -- max(fast,slow)-1+signal-1 -- the first index at which ema(macd(close,12,26),9) is computable at all). It is a conservative round number past the empirically observed convergence point (last disagreeing index measured at 197 of 2,031). Bars 210+ (1,821 of 2,031) never disagree again.
